initial_findings.issue: Prefix regex over ps command= cannot establish exact executable identity when executable names contain spaces; argv can be spoofed.

observed: PROBE: would send kill -TERM 12345 to helper-prefix match

initial_findings.issue: Staged verifier does not validate bundle IDs or signed Identifiers of the new products or widget extension point.

initial_findings.counterexample: In-memory fixture generator transformation produced com.fixture.otherapp and its widget while the unchanged original child verifier accepted V1.
initial_findings.fix: Check exact Info.plist and signed IDs, executable/package types and NSExtensionPointIdentifier; add wrong-product fixtures.

initial_findings.issue: Decoded Int.max is incremented outside do/catch and traps on the next write.
initial_findings.required_property: Malformed or foreign snapshot must not crash the writer.
initial_findings.fix: Validate counter range and use checked increment with explicit error/recovery policy; add boundary tests.

initial_findings.issue: Any nonempty pluginkit output proves registration even for another path and even after nonzero tool exit.

initial_findings.issue: Suppressed ps failure is treated as no process or confirmed process exit.
initial_findings.required_property: Failure to observe a process must not authorize replacement while the writer may remain alive.
initial_findings.counterexample: Fake ps always returned 1; original stop function reported not running and returned zero.
initial_findings.fix: Fail explicitly on enumeration failure and distinguish PID disappearance from query errors; add pre/post TERM tool-failure fixtures.

initial_findings.issue: Raw codesign DV identity is persisted before redaction; VOUT/SOUT also bypass build redactor.

round3_findings.issue: Native helper canonicalizes root/Contents/MacOS without requiring that canonical directory remain canonical(root)/Contents/MacOS; a parent directory symlink redefines the authorized boundary outside the given bundle.
round3_findings.required_property: The independently enforced native root/path contract must reject targets outside canonical(bundle-root)/Contents/MacOS before any process signal.
round3_findings.fixed_part: Original wrapper now validates exact safe product basename, verifies old bundle integrity with codesign --verify --strict --deep and rejects parent/file symlink escape before helper. Original argv spoof/traversal defects in wrapper are not reproduced.
round3_findings.counterexample: Unchanged compiled helper, fake Boundary.app/Contents/MacOS symlink to own scratch outside directory and one validated own finite-lived empty C fixture named AI Usage Widget in that outside directory: --list finds it and --stop sends TERM.
observed: TERM sent to exact kernel-path own fixture outside supplied root
round3_findings.timeout_explanation: Python parent reaps fixture after helper returns; zombie remains until then. rc=6 is not used as evidence of confirmed exit, and no timeout finding is added.
round3_findings.fix: Require canonical(root/Contents/MacOS) equal canonical(root)+literal '/Contents/MacOS', without redefining the boundary through a symlink; preserve exact executable/identity checks and fail closed on inspection failures. Add native MacOS- and Contents-directory-symlink tests expecting rc=7 and zero signals.
round3_findings.next_checkable_hypothesis: Canonicalization of the allowed directory must be compared against a root-anchored literal before canonicalizing a supplied target; both parent-directory symlink cases should return 7 with own outside fixtures still alive.
round3_findings.quality_escalation_recommendation: Kimi high for boundary contract after two failed GLM fixes; Sol high for security-boundary cost per HQ policy. No dispatch or implementation authorized by this review.

round3_findings.issue: Native self-test appends every fixture PID permanently and retains reaped PIDs until EXIT; cleanup issues TERM then unconditional KILL to historical numbers without current child, kernel path or birth identity validation.
round3_findings.required_property: Fixture test isolation must restrict all cleanup signals to still-owned validated self-spawned instances, not historical PID numbers.
round3_findings.counterexample: Original cleanup function with PIDS_FILE containing a synthetic stale 987654 and stub kill/rm logs both signal calls, including -9, without any identity query.
round3_findings.fix: Remove completed/reaped fixtures from active cleanup set; revalidate owner/path/birth before emergency signals or await finite-lived fixtures without blanket KILL. Add deterministic changed-identity cleanup test requiring zero TERM/KILL calls.

round2_findings.issue: Unvalidated CFBundleExecutable can escape the authorized app via traversal or symlink; realpath canonicalizes this foreign target rather than enforcing the app boundary. codesign -dv reads team metadata without validating modified old bundle integrity.
round2_findings.required_property: Only an executable inside the canonical authorized installed app may receive TERM; old-bundle metadata must not redirect the target.
round2_findings.fixed_part: ps/argv-prefix comparison removed; exact native kernel path and process start identity are implemented and reject a prefix helper with spoofed argv[0].
round2_findings.counterexample: In fake HOME, correct app bundle ID plus CFBundleExecutable=../../../../../Empty Fixture and expected-team codesign stub redirected the original wrapper/native helper to the reviewer's own empty C fixture outside fake app.
observed: TERM sent to exact kernel-path instance outside fake bundle
round2_findings.fix: Validate old-bundle integrity/identity and exact executable basename; fail on traversal/symlink outside canonical authorized root before process calls. Add zero-signal escape fixtures; preserve one TERM/no KILL and instance revalidation.

round2_findings.issue: Indented pluginkit record headers hit awk's whitespace/next rule, so only the last Path/SDK pair survives; election state is not parsed. Valid exact registration is order-dependent and an ignored exact registration passes.
round2_findings.required_property: Parse all physical registration records independently, match canonical installed path and supported state after a successful tool result.
round2_findings.fixed_part: Nonzero pluginkit result and single stale-path-only fixture are rejected; Path/SDK format and WidgetKit SDK value independently confirmed against current system output.
round2_findings.counterexample: Two versions, exact (1.0) first and stale (2.0) last, fail; reversed order passes. Exact header with '-' election passes.
references: readonly /usr/bin/pluginkit -mAvv -p com.apple.widgetkit-extension: rc=0; 39 Path fields, 39 SDK fields, zero bare absolute appex-path lines
round2_findings.fix: Flush/reset on each actual header, preserve election, normalize paths, use -D when all physical instances are required; test both multi-version orders, ignored/superseded states, duplicates and canonical paths. Do not label an unobserved bare-path fixture official.

round2_findings.issue: Initial search collapses proc_pidpath errors and disappeared PIDs to nil/continue, then returns absence (3). Wrapper accepts 3 and can authorize replacement with a live uninspectable target.
round2_findings.required_property: An inspection error on relevant live owner processes must not be evidence of absence or completed exit.
round2_findings.fixed_part: Full proc_listpids failure returns 2 and wrapper fails; post-TERM waiting distinguishes ESRCH/EPERM.
round2_findings.counterexample: A scratch DYLD interpose hook returns 0/EACCES only for the reviewer's known live empty fixture PID; other proc_pidpath calls remain native. Helper --stop returns 3 while fixture is still alive.
round2_findings.fix: Restrict/classify relevant owner PIDs and distinguish ESRCH disappearance from inspection errors before matching. Fail closed on unknown relevant state; add native path-query failure test, not only a preclassified rc=2 shell stub.

round2_findings.issue: GROUP_SUFFIX=group.aiusage is interpolated into a regex with an unescaped dot, admitting a different group (groupXaiusage); canonical-path check then validates that wrongly admitted directory.
round2_findings.required_property: Diagnostics must list only the exact expected-team group.aiusage container.
round2_findings.fixed_part: Original traversal and container symlink escapes are rejected; bundle ID and expected team are checked before listing.
round2_findings.counterexample: Original group_container_section in fake HOME with correct bundle/team and AppGroupID=TESTTEAMID.groupXaiusage lists FOREIGN_GROUP_FILENAME from that other fixture directory.
round2_findings.fix: Use exact string equality for gid against team+'.'+GROUP_SUFFIX before constructing paths; retain canonical-directory checks. Test substitutions at every dot/suffix position and assert exported filename markers.
